issues.message: The PlantUML representation does not include the 'maximum speed' attribute as specified in the requirements for a generic vehicle.
issues.evidence: A Vehicle has a position, a speed and a maximum speed. Besides, it has an environment (with a value among “land”, “water” and “air”). Finally, it can move for a given time. Those are the features of a generic vehicle.
suggestions: Add 'maximum speed' attribute to the Vehicle class in PlantUML representation.

validation_report.requirements:
This system represents different types of vehicles. 
A Vehicle has a position, a speed and a maximum speed. Besides, it has an environment (with a value among “land”, “water” and “air”). Finally, it can move for a given time. Those are the features of a generic vehicle.
Then, we have land vehicles and marine vehicles as specific types of vehicles, where both have all the same features as a vehicle. Finally, an amphibious vehicle can be both a land vehicle and a marine vehicle.
